question: In a Wheatstone bridge, the resistances in the four arms are $P=2\,\Omega$, $Q=3\,\Omega$, $R=4\,\Omega$, and $S=6\,\Omega$. Check whether the bridge is balanced. Justify your answer.

options.A: Yes, the bridge is balanced because $\dfrac{P}{Q}=\dfrac{2}{3}$ and $\dfrac{R}{S}=\dfrac{4}{6}=\dfrac{2}{3}$.
options.B: No, the bridge is unbalanced because $P+Q\ne R+S$.
options.C: No, the bridge is unbalanced because $\dfrac{P}{R}\ne\dfrac{Q}{S}$.
options.D: Yes, the bridge is balanced because all four resistances are different.
